title: ATTACHED TABLE — Criteria for Designating a National Career Education Center
full_text:
ATTACHED TABLE — Criteria for Designating a National Career Education Center
[Attached Table to the Enforcement Rule of the Career Education Act; amended November 21, 2023; related to Article 3 (2)]

1. PERSONNEL CRITERIA
At least one full-time employee shall be employed to perform duties for the promotion and support of career education who falls under any of the following categories:
(a) A person who has obtained a doctoral degree in a field related to career education from a school specified in Article 2, subparagraphs 1 through 3 or 5, of the Higher Education Act, or who is recognized under another statute as possessing equivalent academic qualifications.
(b) A person who has obtained a master's degree in a field related to career education from such a school, or equivalent academic qualifications recognized under another statute, and has at least three years of research or work experience related to career education.
(c) A person who has obtained a bachelor's degree in a field related to career education from such a school, or equivalent academic qualifications recognized under another statute, and has at least five years of research or work experience related to career education.
(d) A person who has obtained an associate degree in a field related to career education from a junior college under Article 2, subparagraph 4, of the Higher Education Act, or equivalent academic qualifications recognized under another statute, and has at least seven years of research or work experience related to career education.
(e) A person who holds a qualification as a vocational counselor under attached Table 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the National Technical Qualifications Act, or as a youth instructor or youth counselor under Article 21 or 22 of the Framework Act on Youth, and has at least three years of research or work experience related to career education.
(f) A person recognized by the Minister of Education as having qualifications equivalent to those referred to in items (a) through (e).

2. FACILITY CRITERIA
The center shall have a separate meeting room and office necessary for providing and supporting career education.

NOTES
1. "Fields related to career education" means industrial workforce development studies, career counseling, counseling studies, education, psychology, educational psychology, youth psychology and similar majors.
2. "Research or work experience related to career education" means experience falling under any of the following categories. Both experience acquired before and experience acquired after obtaining or being recognized as holding the relevant degree, academic qualifications or professional certification specified in the table above shall be included:
(a) Experience in teaching, instruction or counseling related to career education;
(b) Experience in administrative or research work relating to the career education policies of the State or a local government;
(c) Experience in career education-related duties at a research institution under Article 8 (1) of the Act on the Establishment, Operation and Fostering of Government-Funded Research Institutes, a public institution under Article 4 of the Act on the Management of Public Institutions, or a local public enterprise under Article 2 of the Local Public Enterprises Act;
(d) Other experience recognized by the Minister of Education as equivalent to the research or work experience referred to in items (a) through (c).
